name: FirstSun Capital Bancorp
summary: FirstSun Capital Bancorp operates as the bank holding company for Sunflower Bank, National Association that provides commercial and consumer banking and financial services to small and medium-sized companies in the United States. It operates through Banking and Mortgage Operations segments. The company offers noninterest and interest-bearing deposit accounts, checking and savings accounts, money market and term certificate accounts, and treasury management products and services, as well as certificates of deposit.
